results.title: Chinese National Kidnapped in Congo Ambush
results.snippet:
Armed men ambushed a vehicle on the Kalemie-Bendera road in Tanganyika province, a region of southeastern DR Congo on Lake Tanganyika, killing two people and kidnapping a Chinese national, a local official and press reports said on Tuesday 17 November. The attack took place on Saturday 14 November, about 42 km from the lakeside town of Kalemie, at around midday.
